You see a torch.
It weighs 5.00 oz.

Notes

This torch can be Lit in order to provide light for up to 20 minutes. As the torch is used, the light gets weaker and the torch shorter. This first stage of the torch lasts for 10 minutes while lit, when it becomes a Torch (Medium).

It was once a very useful item before the client had the option to set the ambient light off. People always carried one of these in their belt to save mana in hunts from casting light spells. Since the ambient light feature was implemented, torches were left behind, and nowadays they are almost completely useless.

Obtainable in The Beginning Quest.
